sql: SELECT audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Name') AS file_name, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.UpdateReasons') AS update_reasons FROM unified_events WHERE case_id = ? AND artifact_id = 'usn_journal' AND ((json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Extension') = '.locked' AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.UpdateReasons') ILIKE '%RenameNewName%') OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Name') ILIKE 'README_RESTORE%')

rule_meta.title: Ransomware Encryption: Mass Rename To .locked + Ransom Note
